recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1970s album cover featuring a central male figure in a brown leather coat and hat, set against a desaturated, slightly textured teal-grey background. The layout uses bold, geometric sans-serif display type at the top and secondary sans-serif text in the lower-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the right, looking back toward the left negative space.
Large display typography spanning the top edge, partially overlapping the subject's hat.
Color harmony between the warm browns of the clothing and the cool, muted background tone.
coreInvariants: Muted, desaturated color palette with high grain texture.
Geometric sans-serif display type with thin internal inline or outline details.
Three-quarter length portrait with a dynamic, walking-like pose.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and the large, bright green-outlined display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large name at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the coat down to the tracklist in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side of the frame, providing balance for the text blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown and tan (subject's attire)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and light background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and desaturated pastels

letterConstructionRules: Thin internal inline stroke that creates a double-line effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' has a high junction point
The 'E' has a very short middle bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric display paired with light, narrow sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Small corner logos in black boxes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and circular forms.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s-style studio portrait of a man in a brown leather coat and fedora, smiling and looking over his shoulder. The background is a flat, textured teal-grey wall with visible film grain and slight vignetting. The lighting is soft and directional from the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large geometric sans-serif text in all-caps across the top, using a black fill and thin green outline. Place a smaller block of light-weight sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner, left-aligned, in a muted blue color.

verificationChecks: Is the display text overlapping the hat?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?
Is there significant negative space on the left?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
Specific catalog numbers in the top left
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography is perfectly horizontal and not warped.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure facial features.
Verify the 'inline' effect on the top text is crisp.
Confirm the bottom-left text block is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject on right + Geometric inline display text on top + Light sans-serif block in bottom-left negative space + Muted earth-tone palette.
